components.name: Default Button
components.description: Compact neutral action used throughout toolbar, dialogs, and pane controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { font: 12px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--text-dim, #9a9aa8); background: var(--surface-2, #1b1b22); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a34); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s, color .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-btn-default:hover { color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface-3, #23232c); border-color: var(--border-strong, #3a3a48); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: translateY(.5px); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clearest forward action in a local decision.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 12px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #fff; background: var(--accent, #7c6cff); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s, transform .12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8b7cff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(.5px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet cancellation or secondary toolbar action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font: 12px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--text-dim, #9a9aa8); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s, color .12s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface-2, #1b1b22); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Technical Input
components.description: Compact field for search, paths, identifiers, and other machine-facing values.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 220px; font: 12px/1.35 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface-3, #23232c); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a34); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); padding: 4px 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color .12s, box-shadow .12s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #3a3a48); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #7c6cff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(124,108,255,.16)); }

components.name: Active Workspace Chip
components.description: Contained active-workspace selector with a restrained focus halo.
components.css: .ds-workspace-chip { min-width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; font: 12px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #fff; background: var(--accent, #7c6cff); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(124,108,255,.16)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-workspace-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-workspace-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Dense active tab with a violet top rule, state dot, and pane count.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; align-items: stretch; min-height: 36px; gap: 2px; padding: 0 8px; background: var(--bg, #0c0c0f); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a34); } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; font: 12px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-faint, #64646f); background: transparent; border: 0; border-top: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-dim, #9a9aa8); background: var(--surface, #141419); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface, #141419); border-top-color: var(--accent, #7c6cff); } .ds-kind-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-2, #4d9fff); } .ds-count { color: var(--text-faint, #64646f); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-pane { width: 420px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--bg, #0c0c0f); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #7c6cff), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft, rgba(124,108,255,.16)); } .ds-pane-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface-2, #1b1b22); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a34); } .ds-pane-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3dd68c; } .ds-pane-title { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-pane-state { padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text-dim, #9a9aa8); background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); font: 10.5px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-terminal { min-height: 112px; padding: 8px; font: 13px/1.15 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-prompt { color: var(--success, #52d273); font-weight: 600; } .ds-cursor { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 14px; vertical-align: -2px; background: var(--accent, #7c6cff); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Floating operational decision with separated title bar and compact actions.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 380px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface, #141419); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3a3a48); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 9px); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5); font: 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a34); } .ds-dialog-head strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dialog-head button { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--text-faint, #64646f); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-head button:hover { color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface-3, #23232c); } .ds-dialog-head button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); } .ds-dialog-body { padding: 12px 16px 16px; } .ds-dialog-body p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--text-dim, #9a9aa8); font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog-actions button { flex: 1; padding: 5px 10px; color: var(--text-dim, #9a9aa8); background: var(--surface-2, #1b1b22); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a34); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-actions button:hover { color: var(--text, #e6e6ec); background: var(--surface-3, #23232c); } .ds-dialog-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Critical Status Banner
components.description: Full-width operational failure or disconnection signal with a pulsing state dot.
components.css: @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .35; } } .ds-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--danger, #ff5c5c); background: var(--danger-soft, rgba(255,92,92,.14)); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,92,92,.3); font: 12px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-banner-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--danger, #ff5c5c); animation: ds-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }

components.name: Mobile Terminal Key
components.description: Thumb-sized on-screen terminal key used when hardware keyboards lack TUI controls.
components.css: .ds-key { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent, #7c6cff); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); font: 13px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-key:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6cff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-key:active { filter: brightness(.94); }

narrative.overview:
Amber is a quiet technical instrument for work that must remain intact. Its near-black workspace recedes behind terminal content, while thin structural borders, compact controls, and precise state signals make many concurrent sessions legible without turning the interface into a spectacle.

The system is precise, resilient, focused, and deliberately low-light. It behaves like infrastructure rather than decoration: hierarchy comes from tonal layers, typography, focus, and operational color. It rejects flashy gamer-terminal styling, decorative glassmorphism, and attention-seeking gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, full-viewport workspace that gives terminal content priority.
Near-black tonal layers separated by fine borders rather than large effects.
Preservation Violet for interaction and focus; Signal Blue for secondary state.
Compact system typography paired with machine-facing monospace.
Strong color and elevation appear only when state or manipulation requires them.

rules.name: The Concentrated Accent Rule
rules.body: Preservation Violet is rare enough to mean active, focused, or actionable; never wash a large resting surface in it.

rules.name: The Operational Color Rule
rules.body: Amber, blue, green, red, cyan, and agent hues communicate state or identity. They are not interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The Human Controls, Machine Truth Rule
rules.body: Use sans-serif for actions and explanations; switch to monospace whenever the interface is showing what a process, path, protocol, or shortcut actually is.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Amber creates hierarchy inside a narrow 10–15px UI range through weight, color, spacing, and type family—not oversized display text.

rules.name: The Terminal Owns the Room Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays compact and peripheral; the pane body receives the overwhelming majority of every viewport.

rules.name: The No-Reflow Overlay Rule
rules.body: Search, freeze prompts, path actions, and transient controls overlay the pane instead of entering terminal layout and changing the PTY geometry.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Ordinary chrome is separated by tone and a one-pixel border. A shadow must explain that a surface is floating, temporary, or moving.

rules.name: The Radius Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use standard rounding for controls, medium rounding for floating containers, and full pills only for compact identity or state—not as a universal softness treatment.

dos: **Do** keep the terminal or editor canvas visually dominant and the chrome compact.
**Do** use tonal Carbon layers and one-pixel graphite borders before reaching for shadow.
**Do** reserve Preservation Violet for focus, active state, selection, and primary action.
**Do** preserve the three-level text hierarchy and use monospace for machine truth.
**Do** maintain visible keyboard focus and 44px touch targets in the coarse-pointer mobile layout.
**Do** communicate process and agent state with the established semantic dots and badges.
donts: **Don't** introduce gamer-neon spectacle, decorative glassmorphism, gradients, or ornamental glow.
**Don't** use Warning Amber as a broad application accent; keep it tied to brand and operational meaning.
**Don't** turn every container into a rounded card or every action into a pill.
**Don't** add large headings that compete with live terminal content.
**Don't** animate layout, terminal output, or controls continuously; motion should acknowledge state, hover, or activity.
**Don't** allow transient pane controls to reflow the PTY or hide critical terminal content without an explicit modal state.
